title: Representable presheaves satisfy fpqc descent
statement: Let $T$ and $X$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $(f_i:T_i\to T)$ be an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For every $i,j$ form the fibre product $T_i\times_T T_j$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $p_1$ and $p_2$. Suppose scheme morphisms $\varphi_i:T_i\to X$ satisfy $\varphi_i\circ p_1=\varphi_j\circ p_2$ for every $i,j$. Then there is a unique scheme morphism $\varphi:T\to X$ satisfying $\varphi\circ f_i=\varphi_i$ for every $i$. Here pullback of a morphism into $X$ along any map means composition with that map, so these equations specify both compatibility and restriction explicitly.
